description: Rename a module, or point it at another GitHub repository, which its next redeploy builds. Pass module_name, github_repo_url or both. One operation runs on a module at a time, and none beside an operation on its project: the refusal names the running job; wait for it with get_job_status, then call again. While RationalBloks is being updated, the call is refused with 'RationalBloks is being updated': call it again in a few minutes.
name: update_module
title: Update Module
